ja: 彼に拡張機能を入れるよう伝えてもらえる？
en: Could you tell him to install extensions?
alternatives: Can you tell him to install extensions?
Could you ask him to install extensions?
point: tell + 人 + to install の形。that 節にしない

ja: こんな便利な拡張機能、初めて見たよ。
en: I've never seen such a useful extension.
alternatives: I've never come across such a useful extension.
I've never seen an extension this useful.
point: 「初めて見た」は never + 現在完了で言う

ja: コマンドを打つのに慣れてきた。
en: I'm getting used to typing commands.
alternatives: I'm getting comfortable typing commands.
I'm getting the hang of typing commands.
point: get used to の to は前置詞、後ろは typing

ja: 失敗した時、もうキャッシュを消してたよ。
en: I'd already cleared the cache when it failed.
alternatives: When it failed, I'd already cleared the cache.
I'd already deleted the cache when it failed.
point: 失敗より前に消していたので had cleared にする

ja: 新しい PC のセットアップ、何かアドバイスある？
en: Got any advice on setting up a new PC?
alternatives: Any tips for setting up a new PC?
Do you have advice on setting up a new PC?
point: advice は数えられないので an advice や advices にしない

ja: インフラ、ステージングは VPN 必須って言ってた？
en: Did infra say staging requires a VPN?
alternatives: Did infra say we need a VPN for staging?
Did the infra team say staging needs a VPN?
point: say の後は that を省いて、そのまま節を続ける

ja: Docker 入れたらこれ実行して。
en: Run this after you install Docker.
alternatives: Run this once Docker is installed.
After installing Docker, run this.
point: after の後は未来のことでも現在形 install

ja: 先週、全員が同じエディタを入れたよ。
en: Everyone installed the same editor last week.
alternatives: Last week, everyone installed the same editor.
Everyone set up the same editor last week.
point: last week があるので installed と過去形にする

ja: 彼女のPCが速ければ、手元で試せるのに。
en: If her PC were faster, she'd test locally.
alternatives: She'd test locally if her PC were faster.
She could test locally with a faster PC.
If her PC was faster, she'd test locally.
point: 現実と違う仮定は if 節に were（過去形）を使う

ja: ボリュームの共有方法、まだ分かってないんだ。
en: I still haven't figured out volume sharing.
alternatives: I haven't worked out volume sharing yet.
I still haven't got my head around volume sharing.
point: 「まだ〜ない」は still haven't、分かるは figure out

ja: リンターの設定を順を追って説明してもらえますか？
en: Could you walk me through your linter setup?
alternatives: Could you take me through the linter setup?
Can you go over your linter setup with me?
point: walk me through ＋ 説明してほしい対象を続ける

ja: 急ぎでも、本番の設定はいじらないでね。
en: Even if it's urgent, don't edit prod config.
alternatives: Don't edit the prod config, even if it's urgent.
Please don't touch prod config, even if it's urgent.
point: 「たとえ〜でも」は even if、禁止は don't で言える

ja: テーマ設定はどこですか？
en: Where is the theme setting?
alternatives: Where's the theme option?
Where do I change the theme?
point: Where の後は is + 主語の語順にする

ja: リンターは保存時、型チェックはコミット時に走ります。
en: Linting runs on save, whereas type checks run on commit.
alternatives: The linter runs on save, while type checks run on commit.
Linting happens on save; type checking happens on commit.
point: 対比は whereas で2つの設定を並べる

ja: 今、拡張機能を入れてるところ。
en: I'm installing an extension now.
alternatives: I'm adding an extension right now.
Right now, I'm installing an extension.
point: 「今〜しているところ」は現在進行形 I'm 〜ing

ja: ビルドの設定を変えてもいいですか？
en: Would you mind if I changed the build settings?
alternatives: Is it okay if I change the build settings?
Could I change the build settings?
point: Would you mind if の後は過去形 changed にする

ja: Docker がメモリをこんなに食うって知ってればなあ。
en: I wish I'd known Docker ate this much memory.
alternatives: If only I'd known Docker used this much memory.
I wish I had known Docker takes up this much memory.
point: 過去の後悔は I wish の後を過去完了 I'd known にする

ja: うちは GitHub を毎日使う。
en: We use GitHub every day.
alternatives: Our team uses GitHub daily.
We work with GitHub every day.
point: 毎日は every day と 2 語で書く

ja: セットアップ用のスクリプトある？
en: Is there a setup script?
alternatives: Do we have a setup script?
Does it have a setup script?
point: 「〜ある？」は Is there 〜? で主語は後ろ

ja: 新人が最初に入れるべきツールの一覧、どこかにある？
en: Is there a list of tools new hires should install?
alternatives: Is there a list of tools new hires need to install?
Is there a list of tools new hires must install?
point: tools の後ろに関係詞なしで new hires should install を続ける

ja: ビルド失敗の原因は、設定じゃなく Node だったよ。
en: It was Node, not the config, that broke the build.
alternatives: What broke the build was Node, not the config.
It wasn't the config but Node that broke the build.
point: It was A, not B, that 〜 で原因を強調する

ja: Docker が使えないんです。
en: I can't use Docker.
alternatives: I'm not able to use Docker.
Docker doesn't work for me.
point: can't の後の動詞は原形の use
